description: This file defines the UriFactory class implementing PSR-17's UriFactoryInterface, used to create Uri objects from strings and global server variables.

classes.name: UriFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create Uri instances from strings or server environment variables, conforming to PSR-17.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a Uri object from a URI string, parsing its components.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a Uri object based on provided server global variables, simulating server request context.
